notes:
Beta 1.0.8 - What's New

Kits and referees
- Home/Away: the game now looks at the real main colour of each kit, including the kits you edit,
  to decide when a team must wear its away kit. Striped kits count both colours.
- Referee: the referee kit is chosen so it never matches the colours of the two teams on the
  pitch, shorts included like the original game.
- New "9999 - Referee" folder inside "teams": the six original referee kits, editable like the
  team kits. You can also add new referee kits (referee_06, referee_07, ...): they are picked at
  random together with the originals, in every mode, when their colours don't clash.
  Friendly and World League now use all six original referee kits too.
- Colours are recognised in the game's own groups (black, blue, sky blue, green, red, orange,
  yellow, white): purple, for example, counts as blue.
- Kit Studio: choose "9999 - Referee" to edit the referee kits; "New referee kit" creates a new
  one. If you open the Kit Studio page with a double-click, it now tells you to use the "Kit
  Studio" button in the launcher.

Rankings
- The top scorers and assists lists now show up to 30th place.

Faster menus
- New "Fast transitions" option in Gameplay Patcher, on by default: shorter waits in Main
  Select, the pre-match summary, World League Auto/Select, the half-time statistics and the CPU
  substitution menu. Music and game speed don't change. Turn it off for the original timing.
